about: Section 14.1 guard paths for this repo (drill A18; docs/automation-foundations.md). No auto path (merge lane, bot-automerge, Dependabot lane) may merge a PR touching any of these: refusal `guard-path refused: <path>`. scripts/lib/guard-paths.mjs ALSO imports GOVERNANCE and isAgentInstructionPath from scripts/lib/autopilot-merge.mjs (not copied here). Globs: ** = any depth, * = within one segment; matched case-insensitively. This file is itself a guard path: changing it is an owner-merged guard change.
